description: A point-in-time register of the policy and legislation changes that bear on money-market pressure (#376, track P of #374). Each entry carries its announcement date and time, its effective date and a primary source URL. A feature may use an entry only from its announcement instant, never from its effective date (docs/decisions/policy-point-in-time.md). No entry is inferred from the SOFR - IORB spread.
unstated_time_rule: When the source gives no release time, time_basis is 'not_stated' and the entry is public from 23:59:59 on its announcement date, the latest instant the date can mean. A decision made on the announcement date never sees it.
